claim_summary: For the cubic line-equilibrium oscillator \(\dot x=a_1y^3-a_2y^2-a_3y+a_4x^2,\ \dot y=-a_5xz,\ \dot z=a_6xy+a_7x^2\) with all \(a_i>0\), the complete equilibrium set consists of exactly three affine lines \(L_0=\{(0,0,z):z\in\mathbb R\}\) and \(L_\pm=\{(0,r_\pm,z):z\in\mathbb R\}\), where \(r_\pm=(a_2\pm\sqrt{a_2^2+4a_1a_3})/(2a_1)\), together with exactly two isolated equilibria \(P_\pm=(-a_6s_\pm/a_7,s_\pm,0)\), where \(s_\pm=(-B\pm\sqrt{B^2+4a_1a_3})/(2a_1)\) and \(B=a_4a_6^2/a_7^2-a_2\). At any line point \((0,r,z)\), the characteristic polynomial is \(\lambda(\lambda^2+a_5zF'(r))\), where \(F(y)=a_1y^3-a_2y^2-a_3y\). Consequently the zero-Hopf locus for positive parameters is precisely the negative half of \(L_0\) and the positive halves of \(L_+\) and \(L_-\): on \(L_0\), \(z<0\) gives \(0,\pm i\sqrt{-a_3a_5z}\); on \(L_\pm\), \(z>0\) gives \(0,\pm i\sqrt{a_5zF'(r_\pm)}\). At \(z=0\) the line spectrum is triple zero, while the opposite half-lines have one positive and one negative real normal eigenvalue. This corrects the equilibrium-line discriminant and the zero-Hopf condition printed in the introducing article. At its parameter set \(a_1=1/10, a_2=\cdots=a_6=1, a_7=1/5\), the three equilibrium lines occur at \(y=0\) and \(y=5\pm\sqrt{35}\), whereas the article's displayed line formula has a negative radicand.
integrity: All equilibrium and spectral formulas were reconstructed from the printed vector field and proved algebraically; symbolic computation was used only as an independent replay of the determinant and substitutions.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to the printed three-dimensional vector field with all seven parameters strictly positive.
The zero-Hopf classification is linear-spectral; no nonlinear center-manifold stability or periodic-orbit bifurcation theorem is claimed.
The work does not reassess the source's numerical chaos, synchronization, control, or secure-communications results.
title: Complete equilibrium geometry and zero-Hopf strata of a cubic line-equilibrium oscillator
